precheck.description: new InventoryType values do not both exist
precheck.sql:
SELECT NOT (
                EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM pg_enum e
                  JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
                  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
                  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
                    AND t.typname = 'InventoryType'
                    AND e.enumlabel = 'SENT_FOR_REFILL'
                )
                AND
                EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM pg_enum e
                  JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
                  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
                  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
                    AND t.typname = 'InventoryType'
                    AND e.enumlabel = 'REFILL_RECEIVED'
                )
              )

execute.sql:
ALTER TYPE "public"."InventoryType"
              ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'SENT_FOR_REFILL'
              BEFORE 'ADJUSTMENT'

ALTER TYPE "public"."InventoryType"
              ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'REFILL_RECEIVED'
              BEFORE 'ADJUSTMENT'

postcheck.sql:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM pg_enum e
                  JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
                  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
                  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
                    AND t.typname = 'InventoryType'
                    AND e.enumlabel = 'SENT_FOR_REFILL'
                )
                AND
                EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM pg_enum e
                  JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = e.enumtypid
                  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
                  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
                    AND t.typname = 'InventoryType'
                    AND e.enumlabel = 'REFILL_RECEIVED'
                )

precheck.description: InventoryStatus and status column do not both exist
precheck.sql:
SELECT NOT (
                EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM pg_type t
                  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.typnamespace
                  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
                    AND t.typname = 'InventoryStatus'
                )
                AND
                EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM information_schema.columns
                  WHERE table_schema = 'public'
                    AND table_name = 'inventory'
                    AND column_name = 'status'
                )
              )

execute.sql:
ALTER TABLE "public"."inventory"
              ADD COLUMN "status" "public"."InventoryStatus"
              NOT NULL
              DEFAULT 'FILLED'

postcheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM information_schema.columns
                WHERE table_schema = 'public'
                  AND table_name = 'inventory'
                  AND column_name = 'status'
              )
